title: Submission Guidelines
markdown:
## Submission Guidelines for Global AI Summit 2025

We welcome submissions covering all aspects of artificial intelligence research and applications.

### Topics of Interest
- Machine Learning and Deep Learning
- Natural Language Processing
- Computer Vision
- AI Ethics and Safety
- AI Infrastructure and MLOps

### Requirements
- Abstract must be 100-3000 words
- Include 4-8 relevant keywords
- Specify target track (Research, Applied, Workshop)
- Indicate any special equipment needs

title: Review Criteria
markdown:
## Review Criteria

Submissions will be evaluated on:
1. **Technical Quality** (30%) - Soundness of methodology and results
2. **Novelty** (25%) - Original contribution to the field
3. **Clarity** (20%) - Clear presentation of ideas
4. **Relevance** (15%) - Alignment with conference themes
5. **Impact** (10%) - Potential influence on the field

title: Invite-Only Submissions
markdown:
## AI Research Workshop - Invite Only

This workshop accepts invited submissions only. Use your invite code to submit.

### Requirements
- Original, unpublished research
- Focus on AI safety and alignment
- Maximum 5000 words
- ORCID required for all authors

title: Double-Blind Review
markdown:
## Double-Blind Review

All submissions undergo rigorous peer review.

1. Technical soundness
2. Research significance
3. Novelty of contribution
4. Clarity of presentation
5. Reproducibility
